name: dis-gravity
description: Dis-Gravity - The ultimate Discord bridge for your IDE
author: Anon King

antigravity-discord.allowedUsers.description: Allowed Discord User IDs (comma-separated). Leave empty to allow all users in the channel.

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect host IDE and agent
Visual Studio Code (Native Language Model API / Copilot)
Universal Terminal / CLI Agent (Antigravity agy, Claude Code, Aider, Shell)
antigravity-discord.agentProvider.description: AI Agent Provider to bridge with Discord

enumDescriptions: High-resolution visual table card (PNG) rendered natively in Discord - Mobile & Desktop friendly (Recommended)
Mobile Record Cards (compact key-value items per row, zero line wrapping on mobile screens)
Raw Markdown table (standard GFM pipes without box conversion)
antigravity-discord.tableStyle.description: Style of tabular columns rendered in Discord

antigravity-discord.autoAttachTableImage.description: Automatically render and attach visual table PNG images to Discord messages whenever tables are detected in AI responses

antigravity-discord.cursorPort.description: Remote debugging port for Cursor AI Composer & Chat (--remote-debugging-port)

antigravity-discord.windsurfPort.description: Remote debugging port for Windsurf Cascade Agent (--remote-debugging-port)

antigravity-discord.cliAgentPath.description: Universal CLI agent engine: 'auto' (detects agy, claude, aider), or exact executable path

antigravity-discord.enableCopilotReAct.description: Enable autonomous multi-step ReAct agent loop for VS Code Copilot with tool execution and approvals

antigravity-discord.copilotMaxToolSteps.description: Maximum tool execution iterations per request in VS Code Copilot ReAct loop
